messages.content: Repair the rejected story arc required-event list. Fix only the listed issue without changing unrelated source meaning. Return JSON only.

SOURCE REQUIREMENT
The majority of the film is Amy killing (dismembering, decapitating, etc.) zombies as they try and attack her.

TOTAL BEATS
8

VALIDATOR ISSUE
The emphasized zombie-killing sequence is materially represented in only 4/8 beats; more than half is required.

CURRENT ARC
{"events":[{"id":"beat1","event":"Amy cooks breakfast at home wearing a tight black tank top and denim jeans.","beat_number":1,"state_effects":[{"op":"set_clothing","entity":"Amy","slot":"upper","item":"tight black tank top","damage":"none"},{"op":"set_clothing","entity":"Amy","slot":"lower","item":"denim jeans","damage":"none"}]},{"id":"beat2","event":"A zombie breaks the kitchen door window; Amy sees danger.","beat_number":2,"state_effects":[{"op":"set_threat_state","entity":"zombie1","value":"active"}]},{"id":"beat3","event":"Amy rushes Will and Amber to the basement, gets them inside, locks the basement door, retrieves her pistol and katana, and equips them as zombies attack.","beat_number":3,"state_effects":[{"op":"set_location","entity":"Will","value":"basement"},{"op":"set_location","entity":"Amber","value":"basement"},{"op":"set_barrier_state","entity":"basement door","value":"locked"},{"op":"set_item_state","entity":"pistol","owner":"Amy","value":"equipped"},{"op":"set_item_state","entity":"katana","owner":"Amy","value":"equipped"}]},{"id":"beat4","event":"Amy kills the first attacking zombie.","beat_number":4,"state_effects":[{"op":"set_threat_state","entity":"zombie1","value":"dead"}]},{"id":"beat5","event":"Amy kills another attacking zombie.","beat_number":5,"state_effects":[{"op":"set_threat_state","entity":"zombie2","value":"dead"}]},{"id":"beat6","event":"Amy kills another attacking zombie.","beat_number":6,"state_effects":[{"op":"set_threat_state","entity":"zombie3","value":"dead"}]},{"id":"beat7","event":"Amy kills another attacking zombie.","beat_number":7,"state_effects":[{"op":"set_threat_state","entity":"zombie4","value":"dead"}]},{"id":"beat8","event":"Amy leaves the house blood soaked and lets Will and Amber out of the basement.","beat_number":8,"state_effects":[{"op":"set_condition","entity":"house","value":"blood soaked"},{"op":"set_location","entity":"Will","value":"home"},{"op":"set_location","entity":"Amber","value":"home"}]}]}

REPAIR RULES
- At least 5/8 beats must materially belong to the emphasized zombie-killing/fighting sequence.
- Keep breakfast, breach, children secured, weapons equipped, final blood-soaked outcome, and children released.
- Regroup only adjacent source actions.
- Preserve persistent state effects unless event meaning moves the fact to an adjacent beat.
- Use a distinct threat entity after a prior threat is dead.
- Keep exactly eight events with the same IDs and beat numbers.
- Return one JSON object with only an events array. Do not explain.
